an3.107:1.1: ti. Ruṇṇam idaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ, ummattakam idaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ, komārakam idaṃ bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakaṃ hasitaṃ. Tasmāt iha bhikkhave setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṃ vo dhammapamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyā ti.
